mkdir -p .git/hooks && cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Run mypy on all src Python files
if ! command -v mypy > /dev/null; then
  echo "mypy not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi
mypy src/
RESULT=$?
if [ $RESULT -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "Type-checking failed. Commit aborted." >&2
  exit $RESULT
fi
EOF
chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
